title: DE-LIMP and the UC Davis Proteomics Core pipeline (Claude Code skill)
description:
DE-LIMP is an R/Shiny application and Claude Code skill (ucdavis-proteomics-core-pipeline) for reproducible DIA proteomics: database search with DIA-NN or Sage through validated, instrument-derived parameters; limpa DPC-Quant and limma differential expression; quality and contamination audits; publication-ready Methods; AI-written analysis reports with independent expert and fidelity review; optional audio summaries; and a complete reproducibility bundle for every run. Developed and used by the UC Davis Genome Center Proteomics Core.
